title: Why building an effective sales pipeline takes time
caption: A pipeline has its own ramp-up time, and it does not shrink because you are in a hurry.

why-not-start-later.title: Why not start later
why-not-start-later.keywords: start later, better product, a salesperson, funding, the lag grows, ramp-up time
why-not-start-later.script: You may think you can start later, when you need the money. Maybe you plan to start once the product is better, or once you have a salesperson, or once the funding is in. Each of those sounds sensible. But each of them only makes the lag longer. A pipeline has its own ramp-up time, and it does not shrink because you are in a hurry.
